}

procedure InteriorsFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy InteriorsPolicy
  sheet Projects "Projects" { client: Text, email: Email, review_on: Date, status: Text, retainer: Money, budget_notes: Text private }

  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Projects

  if now_r.status == "on-hold" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.client default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure PoolFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new swimmer, then follow up once"
  policy PoolPolicy
  sheet SwimPasses "SwimPasses" { swimmer: Text, email: Email, expires_on: Date, status: Text, fee: Money, health_flags: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in SwimPasses

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.swimmer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the pool! Reply with any questions."

  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch SwimPasses

  if now_r.status == "expired" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.swimmer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"

}

sop: When a new rider is added to Rides, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 5 days. If by then they're marked "ridden" or "cancelled", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. Let me check the messages before they go out. Never include their private notes.

  allow contact Rides.phone

}
sheets: sheet Rides "Rides" { rider: Text, phone: Phone, ride_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, weight_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure StableFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new rider, then follow up once"
  policy StablePolicy
  sheet Rides "Rides" { rider: Text, phone: Phone, ride_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, weight_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Rides

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.rider default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the stable! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Rides
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ridden" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.rider}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure ArcheryFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new archer, then follow up once"
  policy ArcheryPolicy
  sheet LaneBookings "LaneBookings" { archer: Text, email: Email, lane_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, medical_info: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in LaneBookings

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.archer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the range! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch LaneBookings
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.archer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure FencingWinBack {
  about "Nudge fencers whose bout was long ago"
  policy FencingPolicy
  sheet Fencers "Fencers" { fencer: Text, email: Email, bout_at: DateTime, status: Text, dues: Money, injury_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 09:00

  let all = fetch Fencers
  let old = filter all where days_between(bout_at, today()) >= 60 and status != "left"
  let oldest = sort old by bout_at first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.fencer default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the club."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

program:
procedure PoolcleanFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new owner, then follow up once"
  policy PoolcleanPolicy
  sheet Cleanings "Cleanings" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, clean_on: Date, status: Text, fee: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Cleanings

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the service! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"

  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Cleanings
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "cleaned" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure IcerinkFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new skater, then follow up once"
  policy IcerinkPolicy
  sheet Skaters "Skaters" { skater: Text, email: Email, session_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, medical_info: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Skaters

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.skater}, thanks for choosing the rink! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Skaters
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "skated" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.skater default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure PoolFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new swimmer, then follow up once"
  policy PoolPolicy
  sheet SwimPasses "SwimPasses" { swimmer: Text, email: Email, expires_on: Date, status: Text, fee: Money, health_flags: Text private }

  send ok1

    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.swimmer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure GamestoreFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new player, then follow up once"
  policy GamestorePolicy
  sheet Tournaments "Tournaments" { player: Text, email: Email, event_at: DateTime, status: Text, entry: Money, birthdate: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Tournaments

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.player}, thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Tournaments
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "played" or now_r.status == "withdrawn" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.player}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
